title: Commercial Laser Tag Equipment for Venues | Battle Company

facts.fact: Battle Company has been building laser tag since 2012, according to the vendor.
facts.quote: Building laser tag since 2012. Sold in 40+ countries and all 50 states.

facts.fact: The vendor states its laser tag systems are sold in 40+ countries.
facts.quote: Building laser tag since 2012. Sold in 40+ countries and all 50 states.

facts.fact: The vendor states its laser tag systems are sold in all 50 U.S. states.
facts.quote: Sold in 40+ countries and all 50 states.

facts.fact: The vendor says its Utility Box has 25+ selectable modes, including respawn, weapon upgrades, medic, ammo, flags, and capture points.
facts.quote: It has 25+ modes, including respawn, weapon upgrades, medic, ammo, flags, and capture points.

facts.fact: The vendor says its Wireless 360° Headset uses sensors on both the headset and the gun, and it unlocks healing, splash damage, and melee.
facts.quote: Wireless 360° Headset Sensors on both the headset and the gun mean no cheating, and it unlocks healing, splash damage, and melee.

facts.fact: The vendor says its EDGE system needs power but not internet, so it can run indoors, outdoors, or off a generator.
facts.quote: It needs power, not internet, so it works indoors, outdoors, and even off a generator.

facts.fact: The vendor says remote training is included with onboarding, and in-person and on-site training are available as options.
facts.quote: Remote training is included, and in-person and on-site training are available.

facts.fact: The vendor says it designs, builds, and supports its products in Oak Creek, Wisconsin.
facts.quote: Designed, built, and supported in Oak Creek, WI.

facts.fact: The vendor's sales phone number is listed as 888.798.9616.
